'''''Cheilanthes acrostica''''' is a species of [[Cheilanthes|lip fern]]

==Description==

[[File:Cheilanthes acrostica kz2.jpg|thumb|left|Cheilanthes acrostica in Cyprus]]

The [[frond]]s are arranged in groups.
==Habitat==
''Cheilanthes acrostica'' is found in [[Mediterranean]] areas including [[Iberia]].<ref name=goh>[http://www.gonhs.org/flora.htm Gibraltar Flora] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120829150135/http://www.gonhs.org/flora.htm# |date=2012-08-29 }}, GONHS.org, accessed August 2012</ref> The season is from February to June. Its conservation status is of concern. It grows in [[limestone]] fissures, but it is also found in [[quartzite]]s and [[sandstone]]s and among other loose rocks. It is found at a height of 300 to 900 m.

==Basis==
This plant was first described in 1866.<ref>[http://www.tropicos.org/Name/50321839 Tropicos.org. Missouri Botanical Garden], 20 Aug 2012</ref>
